posts.quote:
Snow up high,
pine smell down low.
A cold, clean
kind of happy.

Between the trees,
a small window
onto something big.

Find a flat rock.
Sit down.
Let the lake
do the talking.

Some colours
you only see
at the end
of a long walk.

Low clouds on the ridge.
No rush to the top.
The mountain will wait.

Stone that took
forever to build.
I can take my time too.

Clear water,
all the way down.
I wish my head
worked like that.
